subject: Activation plan & dependency lattice for Orion Health MAP
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Evan Cole <evan.cole@orionhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed activation lattice & MAP (first pass)

Hi Sophie / Evan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As promised I've sketched a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that organizes the go-live work as a dependency lattice instead of a flat list. The lattice highlights parallel work streams and the critical path so we can shorten overall time-to-production where possible.

Attached: Orion_MAP_v1.xlsx (high-level milestones) and a one-page dependency diagram (PDF).

Key asks from our side so we can finalize dates:
- Confirm a single point of contact for network/VPN (name + email)
- Approve the acceptance criteria column in the MAP (I listed basic smoke tests)
- Identify any procurement or security approvals that create hard date constraints

Suggested timeline (draft):
- Week 0: Kickoff & credentials (Aug 16–20)
- Weeks 1–2: Model staging + schema alignment
- Weeks 3–4: Integration testing + performance tuning
- Week 5: Cutover rehearsal
- Week 6: Go-live

I can consolidate your feedback and hand this to Monica (CS lead) and Karthik (solutions) to produce the implementation backlog and sprint owners.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Orion_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@orionhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed activation lattice & MAP (first pass)

Thanks Alex — this looks promising. Couple quick clarifications before we loop in our engineers:

1) Network contact: Evan Cole (evan.cole@orionhealth.com) — he's on this thread.
2) Procurement: We have a security review block for any external KMS connections; that will likely take 10 business days once we submit the questionnaire.
3) Acceptance criteria: Can you add a short section for data residency checks and token retention verification? Our infra team will need that explicitly called out.

Also, can you confirm the expected downtime window for cutover rehearsals? We need to align with our operations calendar.

If you can update the MAP with the KMS procurement dependency and the residency checks, we'll be closer to locking dates.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Turner
Director, Integrations — Orion Health

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@orionhealth.com>, Evan Cole <evan.cole@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed activation lattice & MAP (first pass)

Sophie —
Appreciate the quick reply. I've:
- Added a KMS procurement node into the lattice and marked it as a blocking dependency for staging credentials.
- Inserted a short 'data residency & token retention' acceptance criteria row.
- Noted a recommended rehearsal window of 02:00–04:00 AM UTC (2 hours) for the cutover rehearsal; we can shorten/shift if that conflicts with your ops.

Attached: updated Orion_MAP_v1.xlsx and a PDF export of the dependency lattice.

Monica / Karthik — looping you in for the implementation handoff. High-level asks for CS/solutions:
- Monica: lead owner for acceptance testing and runbook creation
- Karthik: technical owner for staging infra and performance tuning
- Please provide sprint owners, estimate of effort (T-shirt sizing), and a proposed weekly cadence for checkpoints.

Next step: Monica and Karthik propose the sprint roster by EOD Thu (Aug 6) so we can share a locked MAP with Orion.

Thanks,
Alex
[Attachments: Orion_MAP_v1.xlsx, implementation_dependency_lattice.pdf]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@orionhealth.com>, Evan Cole <evan.cole@orionhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed activation lattice & MAP (first pass) — Handoff notes

Thanks Alex — picked this up. Quick implementation notes and proposed ownership: 

1) Sprint roster (2-week sprints):
   - Sprint 1 owner: Karthik Iyer — Model staging, schema mapping, infra provisioning
   - Sprint 2 owner: Monica Patel — Acceptance tests, runbook drafting, support playbooks
   - Sprint 3 owner: Karthik — Performance tuning & load testing
   - Sprint 4 owner: Monica — Rehearsal, acceptance, go/no-go reviews

2) Acceptance criteria additions:
   - Data residency check: verified region + audit log sampling OK
   - Token retention: validated retention TTL and purge workflow
   - Security: KMS handshake completes and encryption-at-rest confirmed

3) Risk register (high level):
   - Procurement delay for KMS (mitigation: parallelize credential-free staging where possible)
   - Schema mismatch (mitigation: early contract tests week 1)

4) Suggested checkpoints: weekly 30-min sync on Tuesdays 09:00 PT + bi-weekly engineering deep-dive (45 min)

I've uploaded a short implementation playbook (PDF) to the Drive folder and attached the initial risk matrix. If these owners look good to you Sophie, can you confirm and we'll lock the MAP and push the DocuSign SOW link for signatures.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: implementation_playbook_v1.pdf]

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@orionhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Evan Cole <evan.cole@orionhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Activation schedule confirmed + signature link

Monica / Karthik —

Thanks for the clear owners and mitigation notes. We're aligned on the ownership and the Tuesday check-ins; the proposed rehearsal window is acceptable.

Procurement note: We'll begin the KMS security questionnaire tomorrow — Evan is running that and will update the Drive record. That locks the critical-path dependency but we can keep parallel contract tests running.

I've asked procurement to expect the DocuSign SOW — please send the signature-ready link and I'll route internally.

Confirmed dates (locked):
- Kickoff: 2026-08-16
- Model staging complete: 2026-08-30
- Integration & tuning complete: 2026-09-13
- Rehearsal window: 2026-09-20 (02:00–04:00 UTC)
- Go-live target: 2026-09-27

Sophie
Sophie Turner
Director, Integrations — Orion Health
